findings.rootCause: Public checkFamilySplit(cases, calibration, holdout) only examines family membership. No threshold/prompt revision or adjustment-history input or post-holdout gate is present.

findings.observed: Same clean split returns [] with no ability to bind synthetic tuning history or missing history. Context is recorded separately and was not accepted by the public API.
findings.consequence: Family-disjointness cannot certify independent final holdout performance; no actual final performance claim or live-score reuse was executed.

findings.rootCause: The runtime entry point does not validate each case familyId. A missing/null/blank calibration-only family maps to a value absent from holdout and returns no issues.
findings.sourceRequirement: family 구분이나 조정 이력이 없어 독립성을 확인할 수 없음.
findings.observed: Deleting or clearing SS03 familyId produces [] instead of rejection or deferral. These inputs violate the TypeScript string type; no runtime check is provided by this exported helper.
findings.consequence: Caller must validate family records before relying on family split check. Frozen baseline fixture is well-formed.

findings.rootCause: new Map(cases.map(...)) overwrites a duplicate caseId with the last familyId; uniqueness is checked only for split IDs, not source rows.
findings.sourceRequirement: 의미군 교집합 0, 정답·분할·threshold·프롬프트 revision 고정. 잘못된 split 변형은 반드시 FAIL한다.
findings.observed: SS01 calibration and SS02 holdout returns FAMILY_LEAKAGE. Appending a duplicate SS02 row with conflicting familyId makes the same split return [].
findings.consequence: Conflicting duplicate source rows can conceal translation family leakage at the helper boundary. No frozen fixture changes were made.
